subject: Critical path: vendor onboarding payment lanes and early-pay eligibility
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralabs.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai; naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — payment lane & PO acceptance

Hi Jonas / Naomi,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. Per procurement, we have two items blocking PO activation for the Proof-of-Concept (Deal AST-3471):

1) Payment terms — our default is Net 60, but we can do 2% 15 if Redwood supports early-pay enrollment.
2) PO routing — we need to confirm the invoice lane (billing@astralabs / invoice@ap.invoice) to match the PO_template you’ll send.

I’ve attached our completed onboarding form (Astra_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf) and procurement asked if you can confirm acceptance window for invoices (do you accept invoices dated after service start). Also tagging Michael (ops) to confirm tax/PO number mapping.

Next steps from our side — we’ll issue a provisional PO once terms are confirmed. Can Redwood provide a short playbook for PO acceptance pathing so our AP team knows how to route invoices?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Astra Labs
Phone: +1-415-555-0199

---
Attachments: Astra_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (application/pdf), PO_template_AST-3471.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralabs.io>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — payment lane & PO acceptance

Elena — thanks for the details and the form. Quick answers:

- We can support Net 60 on standard onboarding.
- Early-pay: Finance runs an eligibility check; for strategic pilots we can support 2% 15 with an early-pay addendum. That requires a short approval (manager + finance) and an updated PO that references the EarlyPay_T&Cs.
- Invoice lane: our AP prefers invoices sent to invoices@redwood.ai with PO number in the subject line and the vendor tax ID in the body.

I’m attaching our PO template (PO_Template_AST-3471.xlsx) for your procurement team. Naomi — can you run quick eligibility and confirm if we need to route to treasury for approval? Karthik, please flag any tax/PO mapping issues.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
D: +1-650-555-0142

---
Attachments: PO_Template_AST-3471.xlsx (xlsx)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralabs.io>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — payment lane & PO acceptance

Jonas / team — running eligibility now. Notes for internal record:

- Vendor risk check passed (standard KYC completed).
- Early-pay program entry requires: signed early-pay addendum, confirmation of invoice acceptance window (we accept invoices dated on/after service start), and treasury sign-off if the requested rate is >1.5% or deal > $250k.

Elena — can Astra confirm expected annual spend for the pilot (ballpark) and whether they will enroll multiple lines or a single master PO? That will determine whether we escalate to treasury.

I’ll return with a proposed approval cadence by EOD Thu.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

---

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralabs.io>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai; jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@astralabs.io>, procurement@astralabs.io
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — payment lane & PO acceptance

Thanks Naomi — quick responses to your questions:

- Estimated spend for pilot: ~$120k over the next 90 days (single PO per project line, likely two lines total).
- We’ll sign an early-pay addendum if Redwood needs it.
- Preferred invoice behavior: one consolidated invoice per month per project line; PO number should be in the invoice header.

Michael notes they can provide a supplier portal screenshot for our AP to validate the invoice ingestion step if that helps. We’d like to avoid treasury if possible; willing to take a standard 2% 15 pilot if Redwood’s approval is straightforward.

Elena

---

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralabs.io>; jonas.weber@redwood.ai; naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — payment lane & PO acceptance

Elena / team — quick internal update and proposed next steps: 

1) Because the pilot spend is <= $250k, Naomi can approve early-pay under the finance pilot authority; treasury escalation not required.
2) We’ll issue a short EarlyPay addendum (attached draft: EarlyPay_T&Cs_draft.docx) that references AST-3471 and the PO_Template you returned.
3) PO acceptance: Redwood will accept invoices dated on/after the service start date. Please ensure PO number is in subject and invoice header to avoid ingestion delays.

Action items: 
- Elena / Astra: sign the EarlyPay addendum and return signed PO referencing the AST-3471 PO template.
- Jonas: finalize SOW signature and confirm go-live date so invoices can be accepted.
- Naomi: once signed docs received, process early-pay enrollment and confirm the discount code to be applied on invoices.

If that aligns, we’ll mark the onboarding critical path as: signed PO + signed addendum -> AP onboarding -> invoice ingestion test -> live billing. Target to complete this by Sep 20 to keep POC timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Phone: +1-415-555-0133
